title: Iran Chalus Road
slogan: Tehran to Chalus · 140 km home again

waypoints.name: Tehran
waypoints.advice: Tehran is where the day begins. Next is Karaj, 96 km on.

waypoints.name: Karaj
waypoints.advice: Karaj comes up 96 km in. Next is Kandovan Pass, 97 km on.

waypoints.name: Kandovan Pass
waypoints.advice: 193 km in you reach Kandovan Pass. The road climbs 2700 m over the 97 km before it, steadily. Reckon on about 18 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Chalus, 96 km on and mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Chalus
waypoints.advice: Chalus closes the day.

sections.advice: Tehran → Karaj is 55 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Karaj → Kandovan Pass climbs about 2700 m in 61 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Kandovan Pass → Chalus drops about 2700 m over 70 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.

provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the named road Iran Chalus Road. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.

scenicChapters.title: Karaj → Kandovan Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 95 km. 2700 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Kandovan Pass → Chalus
scenicChapters.narrative: 109 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it. This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

story: 289 km from Tehran to Chālūs, about 3 h 59 of riding. It goes by way of Karaj and Kandovan Pass. The highest point is about 2,700 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
